VERIFIES PRIOR-PASS UNCONFIRMED ITEM: PDS Biotechnology's VERSATILE-002 Phase 2 results (PDS0101 + pembrolizumab in HPV16-positive recurrent/metastatic head & neck squamous cell carcinoma) were published in the 2026-09-17 issue of JAMA Oncology. Specific figures corroborated consistently across multiple independent aggregators citing the same company press release: median OS 39.3 months (95% CI 23.9-NE) in the first-line, ICI-naive, CPS>=1 population vs. a cross-trial historical benchmark of ~17.9 months for standard pembrolizumab-based treatment; ORR 36% investigator / 34% central review in that group; Grade >=3 treatment-related AEs in 13.8% of treated patients (no Grade 5) vs ~17% historically. Cohort: 88 enrolled / 87 treated / 75 efficacy population / 53 ICI-naive CPS>=1 patients. Caveat: this is a company press release picked up by multiple aggregators, not an independent read of the JAMA Oncology article itself; also do not confuse with a separate, earlier Feb 2025 JAMA Oncology publication on a different PDS0101 combination across multiple HPV-associated cancers (median OS 42.4 months) — some secondary sources conflate the two.
catalysts.source: Company press release via GlobeNewswire, syndicated across Finviz, BiopharmaWatch, iTiger, Panabee, BioSpace

catalysts.headline: PDS Biotech discontinues the Phase 3 VERSATILE-003 trial of PDS0101 in recurrent/metastatic head & neck squamous cell carcinoma, citing the capital, time and resources required to complete the study, and will seek external partnerships/funding for PDS0101 instead; refocuses on PDS0301 (IL-12 immunocytokine) as lead program, citing NCI-collaboration data showing a 71% six-month objective response rate and 80% 24-month survival in metastatic MSS/pMMR colorectal cancer with liver metastases
Shareholder letter announced a strategic refocus prioritizing PDS0301 (IL-12 immunocytokine) as the company's lead development program
Board approved a reduction in force of approximately 36% of the workforce to align operating expenses with the PDS0301 program focus
Published positive Stage 1 data from an NCI-led colorectal-cancer combination trial in JCO Oncology Advances: 77.8% six-month response rate vs. 35% in a parallel trial arm without the combination
catalysts.note: Exact August 2026 date not pinned down precisely.

catalysts.headline: Received a Nasdaq bid-price deficiency notice (below $1.00); 180-day compliance period, implying a compliance deadline around 2027-01-26
PDS Biotechnology received a second Nasdaq Minimum Bid Price deficiency notice (Item 3.01 8-K) after previously regaining compliance in June 2026 following the Feb 2026 notice.

Discontinued the VERSATILE-003 Phase 3 trial and halted internal investment in PDS0101 to conserve cash; pivoted focus to PDS0301 in colorectal cancer while seeking a partner for PDS0101; issued a going-concern warning as cash fell to $5.6M (from $27M at 2025 year-end) against $12.4M in current liabilities
catalysts.impact: Major strategic retrenchment driven by a liquidity crunch
